DETAIL op copy rewritten from the user's own practice and accepted. Four points now taught: (1) localised img2img, model sees under the mask, denoise not the prompt decides how far it strays; (2) ~0.30 refines, >0.50 replaces; (3) prompt is OPTIONAL - empty is safest with several masks at low denoise, and when prompting a multi-mask run use BARE NOUNS ('chair, tree, pen') because sentences invite hallucination; (4) pixel budget - a small mask on a small image has too few pixels to rebuild (upscale first), a bigger image needs MORE denoise to move as far. Examples replaced, including a character-LoRA one (mask head or whole body + trigger word = your character) and a removal one.
